# Let me parse the old songs list from the file content and check the show_song API doc.
import re

content = old_songs_file["content"]
lines = content.strip().split("\n")
old_songs = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith("- "):
        # Format: "- <title> by <artists>"
        song_part = line[2:]
        if " by " in song_part:
            title, artists = song_part.rsplit(" by ", 1)
            old_songs.append({"title": title.strip(), "artists": artists.strip()})
        else:
            old_songs.append({"title": song_part.strip(), "artists": ""})

print(f"Total old songs: {len(old_songs)}")
for s in old_songs:
    print(f"  {s['title']} by {s['artists']}")
